chunks: Sulaymān ibn Khālid narrated to me from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.
He said: The qunūt on the day of الجمعة is in the first rakʿah.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: title of Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الْأُولَى: the first one; here, the first rakʿah
key_terms.الْقُنُوتُ: the supplicatory act performed in salat at a designated point
key_terms.يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ: Friday, specifically in the context of the congregational Friday prayer

ai.seo_question: In which rakʿah is the qunūt performed in Salat al-Jumuʿah according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the ruling for the placement of qunūt in Salat al-Jumuʿah. It indicates that on Friday, the qunūt is performed in the first rakʿah, making it relevant to the fiqh of congregational worship.
